It suits families or small groups wanting a base in the city itself, with Portugal Active's concierge on call 24/7 given 72 hours' notice.

696533af4fe6a100145fecb6.tagline: A one-bedroom retreat on the Amorosa seafront, minutes from Viana do Castelo.
696533af4fe6a100145fecb6.description:
White Charm by the Sea is a one-bedroom apartment set right on the Amorosa seafront, with the ocean at its doorstep. The main bedroom holds a comfortable double bed, while the open living and dining area leads out to a private balcony. The kitchen is fully equipped for daily cooking, and the bathroom has a walk-in shower. A private entrance and lift access keep arrivals and departures simple.

The apartment sits in Amorosa, a seaside neighbourhood on the edge of Viana do Castelo, in Portugal's Minho region. Amorosa is known for its long sandy beach and natural dunes, a quieter stretch of coast than the town centre, which is just minutes away by car. Cycling, fishing and water sports are all within easy reach along this part of the coast.

Mornings start on the balcony, coffee in hand, with the beach a short walk beyond the door. Days can be spent on the sand or exploring the dunes, before returning to cook with local produce in the well-equipped kitchen. Evenings settle into the living area, doors open to the sea air, before a stroll into Viana do Castelo for dinner.

It suits couples or a small family of up to four, happiest close to the sea and within reach of town; Portugal Active's local team looks after every stay.

696533794b583900135cf0fc.tagline: A calm apartment near Cabedelo's waves, minutes from Viana do Castelo's centre.
696533794b583900135cf0fc.description:
Yellow Breeze is a compact one-bedroom apartment set up for easy coastal living. The bedroom has a king-size bed, the living room a sofa bed for a third guest, and the kitchen is fully equipped for everyday cooking. A private balcony and lift access complete the practical layout, all within a quiet residential building.

The apartment sits close to Praia do Cabedelo, known internationally for windsurfing, kitesurfing and surfing, with surf schools and kitesurfing lessons nearby. Viana do Castelo's city centre, with its cafés and restaurants, is a short distance away, keeping both beach and town within easy reach.

Mornings suit a walk to Cabedelo to watch the kitesurfers before the wind picks up, coffee made in the apartment's own kitchen, then lunch in town among the local restaurants. Evenings are for the balcony, unwinding after a day spent between sand and streets.

Suited to couples or small families after a quiet base with genuine access to water sports and city life, with Portugal Active's concierge on hand throughout the stay.

6a3549e5edd13800142415e0.tagline: Six bedrooms, a heated pool and a garden made for long family days in Trofa
6a3549e5edd13800142415e0.description:
Canopy House sits on a quiet residential street in Trofa, arranged around six bedrooms and six bathrooms for up to 14 guests, including a self-contained en-suite bedroom in an independent annex. The interiors are bright and contemporary, with generous living and dining areas and a fully equipped kitchen for family cooking. Outside, a private plunge pool (heating available on request) sits alongside a barbecue area, patio and garden.

Trofa lies between Porto and Braga, and the house is a short walk from Nossa Senhora das Dores Park, useful for morning legs-stretching or a run before breakfast. The residential setting keeps things calm while both cities remain within easy reach for a day out.

Mornings start with coffee on the patio and a walk through the park before the day warms up. Afternoons settle around the pool, with the barbecue lit as evening approaches and the whole group gathered at the outdoor table.

Canopy House suits multigenerational families or groups of friends who want space and privacy together, with Portugal Active's local team on hand throughout the stay.

69c418871eabf900141bed48.tagline: A 300-year-old watermill loft on the Coura River, where U2 once stayed
69c418871eabf900141bed48.description:
Loft U2 occupies part of a 300-year-old watermill on the banks of the Coura River, one of three independent lofts within the building. Stone and timber walls frame two bedrooms — one double, one twin — sleeping up to four, with a kitchenette, dining table and private outdoor space with garden and river access. Air conditioning, heating and a washer-dryer cover the practical side.

The loft sits in Vilar de Mouros, a riverside village in Alto Minho known for hosting Portugal's oldest music festival, and for the Coura's crystal-clear water and sandy banks. Caminha, with its medieval centre and ferry crossing to Spain, is 5km away; Vila Nova de Cerveira and its hilltop castle sit closer still, and the Atlantic beaches at Moledo and Vila Praia de Âncora are 10km off.

Mornings start with coffee on the patio and the sound of the Coura running past. Days can be spent swimming from the river beach at the doorstep, kayaking, or cycling into Caminha; evenings settle back into the garden or by the water, with the mill's stone walls holding the day's warmth.

Suited to couples or small families wanting a quiet base in Alto Minho, with Portugal Active's local team on hand for arrangements and recommendations.
